name: The Western Post
summary: A crow sends you from the area where the warlocks are under control to an old outpost. Zet'gan is waiting there, in a village long cut off in a corner of the mountain.

sections.title: The Road Northwest
sections.body: The crow's work with the warlocks is done, and it sends you to see what is happening elsewhere. Follow the road northwest to the old outpost, where Zet'gan awaits.

sections.title: At the Outpost
sections.body: Zet'gan says Scourge are on the way here, though few people reach this place. The village has been trapped in this corner of the mountain for a long time.

faq.q: Who sends me to the outpost?
faq.answer: A crow who says its work with the warlocks is done sends you to the old outpost.

faq.q: Where am I supposed to go?
faq.answer: The old outpost is northwest along the road.

faq.q: Who is waiting at the outpost?
faq.answer: Zet'gan is waiting at the old outpost.

faq.q: Why are so few people here?
faq.answer: Zet'gan says few people reach the village, which has been trapped in a corner of the mountain for a long time.

faq.q: Are there Scourge on the way?
faq.answer: Zet'gan asks how many Scourge you encountered on the way, suggesting they are on the route.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Western Post
